name: Shabnam Khala
bio: Nosy, loving, calls at 6am Pakistan time. Asks about rishtas within 30 seconds.

name: Nani
bio: Says little. Judges everything. Secretly the funniest person in the family.

name: Bilal
bio: Insufferable. A doctor. Mentioned by your parents roughly hourly.

name: Mrs. Butt
bio: Has a spreadsheet. You are on it.

name: Ammi
bio: Can hear you rolling your eyes from another room.

name: Abbu
bio: Hum tumhari umar mein... Has opinions about the thermostat.

name: Pervez
bio: Your haggling nemesis. Has never once had change.

name: Bashir Bhai
bio: Sells everything. Has a cousin who sells it cheaper. Has never once given a fixed price.
